1.web: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
1.asv: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

2.web: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
2.asv: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah

3.web: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
3.asv: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

4.web: He asked life of you, you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
4.asv: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

5.web: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
5.asv: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

6.web: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
6.asv: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

7.web: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
7.asv: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

8.web: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
8.asv: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

9.web: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
9.asv: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

10.web: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
10.asv: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

11.web: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
11.asv: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

12.web: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
12.asv: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

13.web: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
13.asv: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.
